title: The polo, the first private
logline: The maroon polo on its hanger on the garage door's hook, from behind the hanger, the first time the private pages draw the uniform. Ten years of it. A back that isn't even a back.

panels.composition: A maroon polo shirt on a wire hanger hung from a hook on a garage door, seen from behind the shirt, a dog's leash on the next hook.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a maroon polo shirt on a wire hanger hung from a hook on a garage door seen from behind the shirt with a dog's leash on the next hook, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: A back that isn't even a back.
